verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shopify has a programmatic GraphQL Admin API that POS extensions can call, and the vendor claims integration with existing software. Nothing documents that POS UI actions (cart building, checkout, staff PINs, smart grid edits, quick counts) can be done through an API, so parity is unproven. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity for POS workflows, a POS-specific API reference covering checkout and staff actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Extensions can also query the GraphQL Admin API directly using standard fetch() calls.
Integrate with your existing software and easily customize with low-code and no-code options.
